name.description: The name of the library (without 'lib-' prefix)

directory.description: The directory where the library will be created (e.g., 'libs' or 'libs/utils')

type.description: The type tag for module boundary enforcement

publishable.description: Whether the library should be publishable to npm (if true, runs make-publishable generator)

keywords.description: npm keywords for the package, used only when publishable is true

compatibility.description: Runtime profile written to metadata.compatibility in project.json, required when publishable is true: 'isomorphic' runs in Node, browsers and Web Workers, 'node-only' runs in Node alone, 'browser-only' runs in browsers and Web Workers
